01 / PURPOSE

Goal

Drive360 aims to make it easier for drivers to see what’s happening around them and gather the details after an incident. The project brings a connected dashcam, traffic information, and a guided evidence checklist into one mobile app.

02 / THE APP

Project Overview

Drive360 pairs an Expo and React Native app with a Raspberry Pi camera. Firebase handles sign-in and connects the app to traffic and plate recognition services.

03 / DEVELOPMENT

Steps Taken to Develop This Project

  1. 01

    Ported the mobile app

    Rebuilt the original Flutter screens in Expo, React Native, and TypeScript, retaining the navigation and Firebase sign-in.

  2. 02

    Connected the Raspberry Pi camera

    Added local network discovery and integrated the Pi’s live video stream and license plate readings into the app.

  3. 03

    Integrated traffic and incident tools

    Connected the map to TomTom traffic incidents through Firebase and built screens for incident review and guided evidence collection.
